description.en: The application ID. You can create and query this ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported.

description.zh: 待查询的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The channel ID to query. Only a single ID is supported.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
本接口用于查询在线频道信息。
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### How-To  
This API is used to query online channel information.  
### queries per second (QPS) Limit  
The QPS limit for this API is 10 queries per second per user. If the limit is exceeded, Rate Limiting will be applied to your API Call, which may Impact your business. Please invoke the API reasonably.
